name: ssh
description: Connect to arbitrary remote machines over SSH, run commands, transfer files, and use an interactive terminal.

interface.shortDescription: Operate any remote machine over SSH.
interface.longDescription: SSH connects to arbitrary remote machines using the system ssh and scp clients. It supports remote commands, uploads, downloads, per-call SSH passwords, and persistent interactive terminals with session IDs. Passwords are never command-line arguments. The MCP schema marks passwords writeOnly, though clients may still expose tool inputs in their UI or logs.
defaultPrompt: Run a command or open a persistent interactive terminal on a remote host over SSH.
Upload a local file to a remote host.
Download a file from a remote host.
